'''Rabé''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as one of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaidens]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
===Training===
[[File:RabeAndPadme-QiD.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Padmé Amidala helps Rabé after she twists her ankle during the handmaidens' heavy training.]]
Rabé was born on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and was trained in self-defense and marksmanship alongside her fellow royal handmaidens [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], [[Eirtaé/Legends|Eirtaé]], [[Saché/Legends|Saché]] and [[Yané/Legends|Yané]]. Their rigorous training was supervised by [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] head of security, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]].<ref name="QID">''[[Queen in Disguise]]''</ref>

Rabé's primary duty as a handmaiden, other than [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], was to prepare [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] Amidala's elaborate [[Hair/Legends|hairstyles]].<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> At some point, a new handmaiden called [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]] joined them and accompanied them during training. Only later did it turn out that she was the newly elected queen. On that day, Yané ventured first across the training ground, followed by Eirtaé.<ref name="QID" />

Both handmaids mastered the stations in exemplary fashion. Rabé herself was third in line. Although she was able to hit the [[Training droid/Legends|training droid]] with her blaster, he persistently refused to shut down. Instead, he kept firing on Rabé. Even if they were just stun shots, too many hits would sooner or later kill her. Even the shots of Sabé and Padmé could not handle the droid, so Rabé had to flee from him. She reached a waterfall and hoped to hide there while Yané hurried to the droid rescue service. In the end, Sabé and Padmé, in a daredevil joint action, succeeded in putting the droid out of action and thus saving Rabé. She sprained her ankle, but Padmé looked after her caringly.<ref name="QID" />

Subsequently, Panaka confessed to them that Padmé was not a handmaid, but their queen. This event, and the salvation of Padmé, who she was to serve for years to come, shaped Rabé, strengthening her loyalty to the Queen, as well as her friendship with Sabé and the other handmaids.<ref name="QID" />

===Invasion of Naboo===
====Escaping Naboo====
[[File:Rabe-TPM.png|thumb|180px|Rabé at the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]]]]
In the year [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], half a year later, Rabé's home was circled by [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] warships which blocked any import and export. A little later, the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of Naboo began as a result of failed negotiations during which the handmaids and their queen were arrested. Sabé, in her role as Amidala's personal bodyguard and decoy, had refused to sign a contract mentioned by [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] to legalize the blockade.<ref name="TPM" />

In order to force the Queen to sign, he sent her, along with her little entourage, including Rabé, to a prisoner camp, where they were guarded and escorted by B1 combat droids. However, Rabé and the others were soon rescued on the way there by two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], along a [[Gungan/Legends|gungan]] named [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. Then they fled into the hangar and arrived at the royal ship, with which they managed to escape to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TPM" />

====Tatooine====
Since the spaceship was damaged during the spectacular escape and only by the use of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was able to fly, an emergency landing on the desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Padmé, still in the form of a maid, accompanied Qui-Gon to Mos Espa, while Rabé remained on the side of Eirtaé and the queen with Obi-Wan and pilot [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]]. When they received a rescue call from [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] in the form of a hologram, they were unable to act, as none of them, not even Sabé, could decide without the queen.<ref name="TPM" />

====Coruscant====
The stay lasted a few days, but eventually they traveled on to Coruscant, their real destination. They now had another companion, the boy [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who would join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Attending the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], Rabé and Eirtaé were present at the time when Queen Amidala addressed the Senate of the Trade Federation's involvement.<ref name="TPM" />

====Battle of Naboo====
Amidala did not want to be satisfied with the circumstances and set off home, where Rabé continued to accompany her. To convince the Gungans to cooperate, it was again Sabé, who acted as Queen, Rabé stood during the negotiations directly behind her and Padmé. The real queen made herself known and so Rugor Nass was convinced of her honesty. The appearance of Amidala moved him to help the people in the recapture of Theed. While the Gungans fought the droid army in the open field battle, Rabé, Sabé and Eirtaé led their mistress to infiltrate the palace. As a result of numerous battles inside this building, they were able to win the day.<ref name="TPM" />

====Aftermath====
Rabé was also present during the funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn killed in the course of the fighting by Darth Maul and attended the subsequent parade.<ref name="TPM" />

==Skills and abilities==
Rabé excelled with weapons as well as more subtle forms of persuasion,<ref name="SON">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> and had a lot of patience and was often assigned to soothe Amidala's nerves.<ref name="VD" /> She was also bilingual and was able to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustese]].<ref name="SON" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The diversity of actors who have appeared in Star Wars such as Pernilla August (Anakin's mother), Hugh Quarshie (Captain Panaka), Dhruv Chanchani (Kitster), and Kristina DaSilva ''[sic]'' (Rabé) were chosen for the talent they brought to their roles&mdash;not because they were Swedish, Ghanaian, Indian, or Brazilian.|Lynne Hale|<ref name="Casting">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/production/news20000211.html|text=Episode II Casting Update}}</ref>}}
Rabé was portrayed by [[Wikipedia:Brazilians|Brazilian]] actress [[Cristina da Silva]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" />

Rabé was cut from the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rabé and four other Queen Amidala's handmaidens — [[Eirtaé/Legends|Eirtaé]], [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], [[Saché/Legends|Saché]] and [[Yané/Legends|Yané]] — were intended to be introduced in the game with the [[2005]] "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]." They would have been featured in a quest named "Helping the Handmaidens," included in the Naboo part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the longest questline in the game.<ref name="SWG" />
